summary: At the end of a project update, controller runs ansible-galaxy role install -r roles/requirements.yml into a project-specific cache; the system-wide Enable Role Download setting under Settings > Automation Execution > Job turns this off, and updating the project picks up changes to upstream roles.
questions: How does controller install roles from requirements.yml?
Where must roles/requirements.yml be in my project?
How do I disable automatic role download?
Why isn't my updated role being used in jobs?

answer_card.title: Roles from requirements.yml
answer_card.answer_md:
At the end of each project update, if `<project>/roles/requirements.yml` exists, controller runs:

```
ansible-galaxy role install -r roles/requirements.yml -p <project cache>/requirements_roles -vvv
```

To pick up a new commit in a role repository, update the project (no need to commit to the playbook repo). Enable **Update revision on launch** to refresh roles before every job. Turn the feature off with **Settings > Automation Execution > Job > Enable Role Download**.
